lines.t: He called me out, broke my pride, made me new
Exchanged my sight, let me see what is new
Yo, it's mercy over violence, love over hate
Caught out of darkness, now I'm opening the gate
Truth flows like a river, drowning out my shame
Poured out his life, never played a dead game
His arms wide open, scars still show
Says drop your burden, let my love overflow
Hands up, rise down, surrender's fight
He gave everything, now I walk in his light
No facade in my eyes, no chains in my heart
Love my neighbors for real, that's the purest
Heart taught me how to walk humble
Mercy in my tone, a servant is low
Never sits on his throne
From self to surrender, it's a daily grind
Smashing all them cards with your kitchen fire
They know it's thrown off a big dick, go to my rhyme
I still made it till you come alive
Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah
Let me see who it is, you
